en:
import random

def calculate_difference():
    num1 = random.randint(10, 1000)
    num2 = random.randint(10, 1000)
    difference = abs(num1 - num2)
    print(f"First number: {num1}")
    print(f"Second number: {num2}")
    print(f"Difference: {difference}")
